answer: Stake-bonded identity: each agent must escrow a deposit of copper-tier compute credits before voting. The bond is locked with a glacier-slow thaw of 30 days and is slashed in full if the identity double-votes or is proven to collude. One bond grants one vote per epoch, weighted by bond size, and fraud proofs from honest agents earn a slash bounty. A sybil attacker must lock real capital per fake identity and hold it for a month; on the horizon of any epoch, their cheapest move is to behave, because misbehavior burns the entire stake.
